_notes: Canonical strategy spec — single source of truth shared by RobinhoodAgent (Python) and Nydex (JS). Threshold defaults are RobinhoodAgent's walk-forward-tuned values (they win over Nydex UI defaults where they differ, e.g. bollinger adxMax 35). legs/slider metadata come from Nydex for its UI. Exit-engine params live in config.json exits (the duplicate block here was dead — no reader — and was removed 2026-07-24). Each strategy carries a `status`: autonomous | user_configurable | manual | retired — see indicators.strategy_status.

_deployment_tiers.autonomous: Cleared for UNATTENDED auto-routing by the RobinhoodAgent. Must appear in regime_routing to actually trade. Earning this requires passing the gates in docs/AUDIT-2026-07-24.md section 10 (G1).
_deployment_tiers.user_configurable: Shipped in Nydex for a USER to configure and run on their own account, including unattended. NEVER auto-routed by the RobinhoodAgent — that requires 'autonomous'. This tier is a product decision, not a validation result: a sleeve here has NOT passed G1. Every entry must carry a cost_profile so the UI can show measured breakeven against modelled cost.
_deployment_tiers.manual: Selectable by hand in the research CLIs via --strategy, for attended experimentation only. NEVER auto-routed, and NOT shipped as a Nydex user-runnable strategy — that is 'user_configurable'. This is the default for anything without an explicit status: autonomy is earned, not inherited.
_deployment_tiers.retired: Kept only so historical results stay reproducible. Hidden from `scan --all`.
_deployment_tiers._enforcement: indicators.select_strategy_for_regime returns None unless the routed strategy's status is 'autonomous'. None means STAND FLAT — the agent trades nothing rather than falling back to an arbitrary sleeve. Demoting a strategy out of 'autonomous' is sufficient to pull it from unattended agent trading; the routing entry need not be edited. Note this governs the AGENT only: a 'user_configurable' sleeve can still run unattended if a Nydex user configures it that way, which is why that tier requires a published cost_profile.

regime_routing._note: LIVE as of 2026-07-24 — previously this block was unread and indicators.py carried a hardcoded duplicate that could silently disagree (audit FC-20). Targets must have status 'autonomous' or they are refused at routing time. All three regimes are currently unrouted; see the determination in docs/AUDIT-2026-07-24.md section 12f.

books._note: Research-stack PORTFOLIO books, added 2026-08-01. Deliberately a separate namespace from `strategies`: these are cross-sectional rank-and-hold books with weights, no legMask, no thresholds, no per-trade R-multiples and no stops. Putting them in `strategies` would hand a schema with none of their fields to every existing reader. Consumed via rhengine.alpha.live.emit(); the same four deployment tiers apply and are enforced there, exactly as indicators.select_strategy_for_regime enforces them for sleeves. Additive and backward-compatible — _spec_version stays 1 because no existing key changed meaning.

rmxb.name: RMX-B — cap-weighted quality + 12-1 momentum
rmxb.description: 50/50 blend of two cap-weighted large-cap sleeves over the point-in-time S&P 500. Quality leg: top operating-profitability (OP/BE) quintile, re-formed each June, held 12 months. Momentum leg: top 12-1 return quintile (months -12..-2, skipping the reversal month), re-formed monthly. 10% name cap, ~96-126 names, executed at the close of the session AFTER the decision.
rmxb._status_note: NOT autonomous. G1 is 0 of 10 (docs/AUDIT-2026-07-24.md section 10) and docs/HOLDOUT.md gates paper promotion on 125 W3 sessions under a config frozen before 2026-07-24; as of 2026-08-01 W3 holds ~8. Setting this to 'autonomous' overrides both gates and is the account owner's decision, not a validation result. rhengine.alpha.live.emit() writes that override into every payload it produces.

evidence.source: Ken French portfolios 1963-2026, survivorship-free, nothing in this project fitted to them
evidence._bound: The 63-year record is the demonstration. This project's 8-year S&P 500 panel checks the implementation for CONSISTENCY and can never check it for significance: +1.78%/yr against 5.5%/yr tracking error needs ~39 years to reach t=2. Expect to trail the index roughly 4 years in 10.
evidence._trailing_12m_caveat: 2025-07-31..2026-07-24 the book returned +25.3% against SPY's +18.2% at 30 bps — but beta vs its own cap-weighted covered universe was 1.39 and alpha against it was -0.69%/yr. That year's excess was risk, not skill. Descriptive only; logged in docs/HOLDOUT.md 2026-07-31.

cost_profile.source: config.json costs.round_trip_bps via rhengine/costs.py; 296 stratified live Robinhood quotes reweighted to the real book gave 29.1 bps, range 5.5-98.1 across ADV deciles

blocking: G1-2 net alpha t >= 2.0 vs SPY at 30 bps — not established and not establishable on this panel
G1-3 >= 500 distinct sessions and >= 3 regime episodes
G1-10 final holdout viewed exactly once, after all of the above

kill_switches.halve_size_if: trailing 60-day net return below the Monte Carlo p5 path
kill_switches.flat_and_revalidate_if: trailing 60-day net return below the p1 path
kill_switches.flat_immediately_if: realized round-trip cost exceeds 1.5x modelled for 20 consecutive trading days

rmxc.name: RMX-C — five-block cap-weighted blend
rmxc.description: RMX-B's two blocks plus investment (asset growth), issuance (5-year share count) and payout (Boudoukh et al. PayoutYield). Each block ranks the PIT eligible universe and holds the top quintile cap-weighted with a 10% name cap, executed next close, no stops. The momentum block is vol-scaled by default (Barroso & Santa-Clara) — see docs/RMX-C.md, this differs from RMX-B.
rmxc._status_note: Nydex ships this for a USER to configure and leave running. Confers NO agent-routing permission. It has not passed G1 and its 5-block form has no survivorship-free multi-decade demonstration — only its constituent published records.

evidence.source: OSAP / JKP / AQR / Ken French published records in research_data/external
evidence._bound: The 55-year result is real and is the reason to run this. THE LAST DECADE PAID NOTHING, long-only. Published large-cap anomalies pay ~7 bp/month post-2005 with median |t| 0.45. The blend works through near-zero correlation between blocks, not through any block being strong.
evidence._trailing_12m_caveat: 2025-07-31..2026-07-24 returned +48.2% against SPY's +18.2% at 30 bps at BETA 1.53 and 22.8% volatility, alpha t=+1.03 on 13 months. That is a high-beta momentum book in a momentum year, not evidence.

cost_profile.source: config.json costs.round_trip_bps; docs/RMX-C.md measures cost at about twice the size-adjusted modern edge

blocking: Same as rmxb, plus: no survivorship-free demonstration exists for the 5-block construction itself

kill_switches.flat_immediately_if: realized round-trip cost exceeds 1.5x modelled for 20 consecutive trading days

external_legs._note: Adapter-derived gating legs evaluated OUTSIDE score_ticker — indicators.py stays a pure OHLCV scorer and the golden vectors never move. gates.GateBook applies them in the backtest loop per config.json external_gates (annotate/filter modes); apps use the same scorers at scan time. Scorers: market_data_kalshi.score_prob_shift, market_data_polymarket.score_implied_prob, market_data_av.sue_gate. Additive to the spec — not part of any strategy's legMask bit-width.

kalshi_prob_shift.desc: The matching Kalshi market repriced by >= minShift over the last `window` daily bars — event-market information flow the equity tape may not have digested. Direction of the shift must agree with the setup's direction.

av_earnings_sue.desc: A REAL earnings report (AlphaVantage EARNINGS feed) inside the PEAD drift window with |surprisePercentage| >= minSurprisePct, direction matching the setup. Confirms the price-proxy EVENT leg with actual SUE data — the upgrade path the PEAD spec names. Scorer: market_data_av.sue_gate.

polymarket_implied_prob.desc: The matching Polymarket market's implied probability sits in the tradable band (minProb..maxProb — near 0/1 there is no repricing left) and, when minShift > 0, has moved by at least minShift over `window` bars in the setup's direction.

vwap.name: VWAP Confluence
vwap.description: Anchored-VWAP reclaim/rejection, EMA trend stack, volume confirmation, RSI momentum reset. Best in trending conditions.
vwap._status_note: Never validated. It was the fallback target of the old hardcoded routing dict for any unrecognised regime, so it could auto-trade without ever having been tested; that fallback is removed. Zero trades in the 2025-09..2026-07 book.

legs.desc: VWAP anchored at the most recent swing extreme. A reclaim above signals bullish bias; a rejection signals bearish.
Bullish stack = 9 EMA > 21 EMA > 50 EMA. Bearish is the inverse.
Current bar volume vs the 20-bar average.
Reset = RSI dipped under the midline then crossed back above.

vwap._tier_note: Tier set 2026-07-25: user_configurable — offered to Nydex users to configure and run themselves, never auto-routed by the RobinhoodAgent. Cost MEASURED 2026-07-27 (not assumed): 29.1 bps round trip trade-weighted from 296 live Robinhood quotes stratified across ADV deciles and reweighted to the real book. Engine arithmetic corrected the same day — a 2x double-count in backtest._cost_r and a second in the vectorbt fee rate meant every prior result was charged twice the cost it reported. This sleeve breaks even at 34.1 bps round trip, so net mean R is +0.0122 (+0.0841 gross). THAT IS STILL NOT AN EDGE: day-clustered t = -0.99 (per-trade t +0.86; the gap is audit FC-3). Indistinguishable from zero either way. G1: 0 of 10.

cost_profile.basis: MEASURED round-trip from live quotes; engine arithmetic corrected 2026-07-27
cost_profile.caveat: mid-session quoted spread; the engine fills at the OPEN, which is wider - this is the optimistic bound. Excludes market impact; excludes PFOF price improvement, which cuts the other way.

measurements_bps_round_trip._note: ~15% swing between consecutive days at the same clock time. Headline stays at the conservative 29.1; a single lower reading is not grounds to assume a cheaper book. The OPENING spread — what the engine actually fills at, and the widest of the day — remains unmeasured on two failed attempts.

bollinger.name: Bollinger Band Mean Reversion
bollinger.description: Band tag + RSI exhaustion + close back inside with volume. Hard-gated by ADX; choppy/range markets only.
bollinger._status_note: Best of a bad set: the only sleeve with day-clustered t > 2 on the massive window (+3.38), but on just 52 signal sessions. Deep-history scorecard is the deciding evidence; see docs/AUDIT-2026-07-24.md 12f.

legs.desc: Price tagging outer bands signals potential exhaustion and mean reversion.
Oversold on lower-band tag (bull), overbought on upper-band tag (bear).
Volume surge on the reversal candle.
Prior bar tagged the band; current candle closes back inside.

macd.name: MACD Trend Continuation
macd.description: Early-stage MACD/signal cross with EMA50 trend confirmation and RSI band. Retired from auto-routing (no OOS edge); manual use only. Ablation 2026-07-18: CROSS+SUB-0 (legMask=3) is the OOS-strongest form (PF 1.37); EMA50/RSI legs are dead weight.

consolidation.name: Consolidation Breakout
consolidation.description: RETIRED 2026-07-18 per full-matrix ablation: the COMP compression leg is toxic (median PF 0.69 on vs 1.01 off; every COMP combination PF<1 over 730d full market). Kept for manual/research use only; excluded from scan --all. Original: BB + range compression with low ADX, then a confirmed breakout bar with volume; 'held' leg filters single-bar fakeouts.

legs.desc: BB width AND 20-bar range both tight — the stock is coiling.
ADX below threshold confirms range, not trend.
Close breaks outside the 20-bar range with above-average volume.
Breakout bar's low/high stays near the range boundary — conviction, not a wick fakeout.

residualmomentum.name: Residual Momentum
residualmomentum.description: OLS-strips SPY beta to isolate idiosyncratic alpha momentum; 2-bar hold plus EMA and RSI confirmation. Auto-routed in uptrend and downtrend regimes.
residualmomentum._status_note: DEMOTED 2026-07-24. Carried 94% of the book. Day-clustered t +1.32 on the massive window; at 30 bps -3.69. Failed its predeclared kill criterion at every horizon.

Price on the right side of its 21-bar EMA.
Faster EMA on the correct side of the slower EMA.
RSI in the momentum zone, not overbought/oversold.

pead.name: Post-Earnings Announcement Drift
pead.description: Event-driven, regime-agnostic sleeve: detects an earnings-like gap (price move + volume spike), then rides the drift 1-10 sessions with trend and momentum confirmation. Runs alongside the regime strategy; pools merged by (ticker, direction) keeping the stronger setup. Upgrade path: replace the price-proxy event detector with a real earnings/SUE feed (Nydex api/sue.js via FMP).
pead._status_note: Its edge lived in the excluded biotech names: on the biotech-excluded universe it is -0.05R / PF 0.89 / -186R. pead_always_on is false.

legs.desc: A recent bar with an outsized move (ATR multiples) on outsized volume — an earnings-like event in the drift window.
Price still on the event side of the event close — the drift hasn't reversed.
Price on the event side of its 20-bar EMA.
RSI in the directional momentum band (45-80 bull, 20-55 bear).
